To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the mapping of the entities and the execution order of the ETL processes are based on the conceptual model and that a methodology is provided to perform the mapping.
the conceptual and the logical model of ETL processes are different in nature and that there is a need for a mapping from the conceptual model to the logical model.
we have defined a mapping between conceptual and logical entities and a mapping between conceptual entities and logical workflows.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a methodology for the specification and design of ETL processes.
the mapping between conceptual and logical models for ERL processes.
the development of a methodology that facilitates the transition from the ETL conceptual model to a specific ETL logical model, which can be used by the ETL tool.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed conceptual model is a useful tool for designing and implementing ETL processes, and the proposed mapping is a useful tool in the transition from the design phase to the implementation phase.
our mapping methodology is a practical solution for the transition from a conceptual to a logical ETL workflow.
the mapping of the ETL conceptual model to the logical model is possible.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a conceptual model for ETL process, and a logical model that is a direct consequence of this model.
we have presented a complete methodology to design an ETL process, from the initial conceptual model to the final logical model.
we have developed an ETL model that allows the definition of the data flow in an ETL process at the conceptual level and the automatic generation of its logical counterpart.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the conceptual model is a useful tool in the development of ETL processes.
we have identified a set of guidelines that can be used by ETL developers in order to build ETL workflows.
the mapping is not trivial.
